mapper.sql: SELECT so.id, so.operation_no AS operationNo, s.material_name AS materialName, s.unit, so.stock_id AS stockId, so.operation_type AS operationType, CASE so.operation_type WHEN 0 THEN '入库' WHEN 1 THEN '出库' WHEN 2 THEN '库存调整' ELSE '未知' END AS operationTypeName, so.quantity, so.before_quantity AS beforeQuantity, so.after_quantity AS afterQuantity, so.operator_id AS operatorId, so.operator_name AS operatorName, so.remark, so.operation_time AS operationTime, so.create_time AS createTime FROM stock_operation so LEFT JOIN stock s ON so.stock_id = s.id
